name: Full-Stack Cloudflare SaaS Kit
summary: Opinionated SaaS starter kit on Cloudflare with Next.js, Drizzle ORM, NextAuth, D1 and shadcn/ui.
description: A batteries-included starter kit for building and deploying SaaS products on Cloudflare: Next.js, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM, NextAuth, Cloudflare D1 and Cloudflare Pages. Wrangler scripts cover Pages build, preview, deploy and typegen; Drizzle-kit handles D1 migrations and studio; the README walks through bindings, R2 CORS/file upload and Google OAuth. The same stack runs Supermemory.ai.
contains: Cloudflare SaaS kit: Next.js, TailwindCSS, Drizzle ORM, NextAuth, D1, Pages
Wrangler scripts: pages:build, preview, deploy, cf-typegen
D1 migrations with Drizzle-kit: db:generate, db:migrate:dev/prod, studio
R2 bucket CORS and object upload setup
same stack as Supermemory.ai; 3.7k stars on GitHub
